uplink.description: Status report: 3.0 V, ADC input 6.657 V
uplink._note: TTN example status report (netvox r718ia codec yaml, Apache-2.0). Upstream oracle: Volt 3, ADCRaw 6657. byte3 0x1E=30 -> 3.0 V; bytes[4..5]=0x1A01=6657 mV -> analog.voltage 6.657 V. (The 6657 mV example exceeds the 0-5 V input range but is the upstream illustrative value; the codec applies the mV/1000 scale uniformly.)
